newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end soft as profit-taking continues.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end soft as profit-taking continues.

text.p: Chilean blue chips shed early gains to close softer in moderate as players continued to cash in gains from the recent rally with little demand locally or abroad, said traders.
"The bolsa resumed its retreat after excessive rises last week," said one dealer.

"It's part of the normal cycle and may continue for several The 40-share index ended down 0.58 percent at 132.39 points. The general index shed 0.51 percent to 5,730.5 points amid turnover of 11.4 billion pesos.
Traders noted that the bolsa could hit a new support level at 130 points before resuming its upward tilt.
Risers included forestry firm Infodema which rallied on speculation that the firm may be about to embark on several new projects, said dealers.
Other winners included financial group CB Capitales and CB Transporte e Infrastructura whose stock prices corrected after falling sharply Tuesday, they said.
Losers included Banco Santander, down 1.74 percent at 28-1/4 pesos, power investment firm Enersis, down 1.16 percent at 292-1/2 pesos and telecom Entel which shed 0.5 percent at 2,960 pesos.
